"""Stream independence and degenerate topologies."""
import json, subprocess, sys

PY = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '/workspace/submission/main.py']
FAILURES = []


def run(request):
    data = request if isinstance(request, (bytes, str)) else json.dumps(request)
    if isinstance(data, str):
        data = data.encode()
    proc = subprocess.run(PY, input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:3000])
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())


def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILURES.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:1200])
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:1200])
    else:
        print("pass", name)


def topo():
    return {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100},
                      {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 100}],
            "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 100}],
            "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}


def settings(**kw):
    base = {"trials": 4, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 11, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0,
            "tau": 0, "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}
    base.update(kw)
    return base


PATCH = {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10]], "counters": {
    "low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 10},
    "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 10}}}

# two identical streams keep independent memoisation
request = {"streams": [
    {"topology": topo(), "settings": settings(), "events": [PATCH, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]},
    {"topology": topo(), "settings": settings(), "events": [PATCH, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]},
]}
out = run(request)
first = out["streams"][0]["events"][1]
second = out["streams"][1]["events"][1]
check("streams/independent cache", (first["cache_hit"], second["cache_hit"]), (False, False))
check("streams/same result", first["links"], second["links"])

# a stream without any flow
empty = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100}], "links": [], "external_nodes": []}
request = {"streams": [{"topology": empty, "settings": settings(), "events": [
    {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "a"}]}]}
out = run(request)
events = out["streams"][0]["events"]
check("empty topology/repair", events[0], {"op": "repair", "id": "a", "cache_hit": False,
                                          "links": [], "order": [], "counters": {}})
check("empty topology/validate", events[1], {"op": "validate", "id": "a", "checked": 0, "passed": 0,
                                              "consistent": None, "failed": []})

# a node with an external interface but no link
lonely = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 50}], "links": [],
          "external_nodes": ["A"]}
request = {"streams": [{"topology": lonely, "settings": settings(), "events": [
    {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 7}}},
    {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "a"}]}]}
out = run(request)
events = out["streams"][0]["events"]
check("lonely node/repair", events[1], {"op": "repair", "id": "a", "cache_hit": False, "links": [
    [-1, 0, 7, 1, 1], [0, -1, 0, 1, 1]], "order": [[-1, 0], [0, -1]], "counters": {
        "low_A_origination": {"corrected": 7, "confidence": [1, 1]},
        "low_A_termination": {"corrected": 0, "confidence": [1, 1]}}})
check("lonely node/validate", events[2], {"op": "validate", "id": "a", "checked": 1, "passed": 1,
                                           "consistent": True, "failed": []})

# a node without an external interface ignores its external capacity
mixed = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 50},
                   {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 50}],
         "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 40}], "external_nodes": ["A"]}
request = {"streams": [{"topology": mixed, "settings": settings(), "events": [
    {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_B_origination": {"perturbed": 1}}},
    {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]}]}
out = run(request)
check("mixed/reject unknown counter", out["streams"][0]["events"][0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": False})
request = {"streams": [{"topology": mixed, "settings": settings(), "events": [
    {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 41}}},
    {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]}]}
out = run(request)
check("mixed/reject over capacity", out["streams"][0]["events"][0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": False})

print("failures:", FAILURES)
sys.exit(1 if FAILURES else 0)
PYEOF
